transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this Working-Capital Committee review to order. We're here to evaluate the proposed $6,000,000 supply-chain finance facility for supplier invoices from our approved purchasing division. The preliminary proposal assumes financing 90% of eligible invoices, with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I can make a binding decision on whether this facility may launch and on its operating terms, I need to conduct our standard round-robin review. I'd like to start with credit risk: please share your assessment of the facility. Legal and finance operations, I'll come to you next.

These operational controls need to be incorporated into the facility's operating terms, particularly given the non-recourse structure and payment direction requirements Nadia has just outlined. Without these hold periods and the twice-weekly funding cadence built into the schedule, we risk operational failures on day one.
